balls.text: this one is a nasty delivery by Faulkner for the No. 11. He has been bowling those slower deliveries all this while, but he dishes out a quick short one on the body. Awana had no idea where it went as he took his eyes off the ball while fending it. The ball just lobbed over his head for the keeper to complete the catch

oh no! He has walked down too far down the pitch! It was another low full toss outside off and PK was targeting that backward point area again, but he misses it and for some reason, walks a few paces down the pitch, the keeper has all the time in the world to hit the stumps...
another low full-toss outside off, the batsman just doesn't pick it up and lets it go through to the keeper
charges down the pitch and makes room, he gets a length delivery to deal with too, it is slammed over the bowler's head. A good baseball hit that one.. Couple of bounces and to the boundary
oh that is a good touch shot! He moves outside leg and gets a low full-toss on off, he gets his bat down in time and slices it past point to the boundary
quicker delivery this time, it's full on off stump, the batsman digs it out to long on for a single
another slower delivery, this time it is outside off and it beats the bat
no problems for Praveen in dealing with the slower ball. He was expecting it and plays a perfect 100 yard drive in a golfing range.. Over long-on
bowls a slower delivery, but this one is down the leg side. The keeper dives and gets to it, but doesn't get behind it. It runs down to the boundary at fine leg

now he gets the big wicket! another slower delivery and this one is on the middle stump line. Azhar was making room by moving down leg, but as soon as he saw the fuller length, he went across the line. But the ball went through the gap between the bat and the pad to hit the middle stump
the bowler slows it down this time, it is a length ball outside off which the batsman tries to cut, he gets beaten by that
gets a full delivery and he clobbers it to the boundary at cow-corner
makes room again, this time he hits it squarer, to the fielder at deep cover
he moves outside leg and punches the angled delivery through extra cover. It seemed like a push, but the ball sped across the turf
angled delivery from wide of the crease, it is punched down to long-on for a single
now he follows it up with a quick bouncer, the batsman doesn't pick it and is beaten
bowls a back-of-hand slower delivery, the batsman waits and chops it towards backward point off the back foot
bowls a fuller length delivery on off stump, Harris pushes it down to long-on

he sees the slower delivery and decides that it is time to send it out of the ground, the only issue was that he played it too early. His right hand comes off the handle as he drives that and it goes really really high to come down in the lap of Rahane at long-on
length delivery on the stumps, the batsman waits in the crease and defends it back to the bowler
slower delivery wide outside off stump, the batsman punches it down to long-off
fuller delivery, but this one is on the middle stump line. Chawla pushes it to wide long-on and gets back for  a couple
he bowls it full outside off, Chawla punches it back to the bowler
bowls a slower delivery on the pads, the batsman flicks it straight to square leg
bowls a slower delivery which Chawla steers to third man for a single
back of length delivery just outside off, Azhar guides it to third man
another shortish delivery outside off, doesn't get up too much as well and it's easy picking for Azhar. He hammers it to the deep midwicket boundary
attempts a short ball but it doesn't have the pace to bother the batsman, Azhar pulls it to deep midwicket
bowls length on the pads which Chawla flicks to deep square leg
he tries to play a late cut to a length delivery, but gets beaten
length delivery outside off, Azhar defends it to off
back of length delivery on the stumps, it is pushed down to long-on for a single
this time he goes fuller with an outswinger, the batsman runs it down to third man
back of length delivery on the stumps, comes in a touch into the left-hander, Chawla pushes it towards mid-on for a single
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman works it on the leg side with soft hands

oh this one could have been the end of story for Chawla too as he plays a check drive to a slower delivery and pushes it in the air. Luckily for him, it just drops a couple of meters in front of mid-off

fumble, but Dravid takes it on the second attempt! Mr. Hussey has driven the slower delivery straight to mid-off where Dravid goes low to take it, but palms it over his head. Much to the relief of the bowler, he holds on to it in the second attempt..
back of length delivery on off, Azhar goes back and across and works it towards deep square leg for a single
he waits in the crease and opens the face of the bat very late to steer it to third man
bowls a fuller length outside off, Azhar opens the face of the bat and runs it down towards point where Rahane dives, but is not able to collect it cleanly
back of length delivery just outside off, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
he moves outside leg and opens his stance a bit, then crashes the back of length delivery through backward point
fuller delivery outside off, Azhar comes forward and drives it to deep cover

another edge, another take for the keeper! This one goes across the right-hander after pitching short of length, the batsman tries to do what Gambhir has done so many times in international cricket, he opens the face and guides it to the hands of the keeper, who dives to his right to complete a good catch
he comes forward and slices the length ball straight to point
attempts another yorker but this ends up being a low full-toss outside off, Sathish slaps it off the toe-end off his bat, over midwicket for a boundary
he bowls it full on off stump, the batsman digs it out towards the off side
fuller length delivery outside off, the batsman tries to drive it to off, but it's slower, so he ends up pushing it back to the bowler
another slower delivery that the batsman pushes towards mid-on with soft-hands, Sathish is quick to turn back for a second
takes the pace off this one too, but Hussey chops it down to deep backward point for a couple
bowls a length delivery which the batsman tries to whip to the leg side, but it's slower, so the batsman ends up defending it back to the bowler
good away going delivery outside off, the slower pace on that allows the batsman to adjust late and steer it to third man
back of length delivery that follows the batsman as he makes room, he nudges it to fine leg
it's a boundary, and it's off the outside edge. Good length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and gets a good thick edge through the vacant second slip region
he comes down the pitch to an insiwnger and gets hit on the pads, Sreesanth carries on with his appeal, but that was always going down the leg side
slightly short of length outside off, the batsman again punches it from the crease, to deep cover
length delivery outside off, he cracks it over the non-striker's head without any timing, but with enough power to beat the fielders in the deep
back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman stays in the crease and works it down to fine-leg. But Sreesenth as overstepped..
keeps it there around the off stump, he is really testing the batsman although this was not very quick. The batsman defends it to off
length delivery outside off, just a hint of away swing, the batsman stays on the back foot and dabs it to the off side
stays in the crease and pushes the back of length delivery to cover
length delivery outside off, the batsman dabs it down the pitch and starts running down the pitch, he is rightly sent back
there is the edge! He bowls it on a length and gets it to seam away just enough for the ball to take a nice clean edge. It's an easy catch for the keeper.
keeps it tight on off stump line, the batsman dabs it towards cover where Cooper misfields, but the fielder from the deep charges in to prevent the extra run
bowls a 127 kph length delivery outside off, it swings away a touch, the batsman slices it to point
bowls short of length delivery on off stump that gets good bounce, the batsman plays it to third man
draws an outside edge with an excellent full delivery on off stump that shapes away late, the batsman tries to play it to the on side but gets an edge to third man
goes fuller on the stumps this time, Hussey whips it to deep midwicket for a single
he tries to whack this widish length delivery through the off side without moving his feet, gets beaten
this one is too straight, but it's short of length, the batsman nudges it towards midwicket for a single
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman stays on the back foot and defends it towards point
bowls a tight line and length outside off, the batsman steers it to third man again
short of length delivery on the pads, the batsman dabs it towards deep midwicket with soft hands and that allows him to get back for a couple
he keeps moving outside leg side to make room, this time he guides the length delivery to third man
another back of length delivery on off stump, the batsman waits on the back foot and opens the face to run it down to third man
oh another beauty, this one again carries on with the angle and the batsman plays inside the line
he waits for the length ball and guides it to third man for a single
bowls a short of length delivery on off stump that carries on with the angle and beats the bat
slower length delivery on the stumps, the batsman whips it with a wristy shot, straight to mid-on though
slower delivery outside off, the batsman is again making room and ends up slicing this one over the infield, he is lucky as it just drops down before Watson from cover can get to it
this pace is easy and on this hard pitch, it's making it easier for the batsmen. Hussey again makes room and just times the length ball through the gap at cover point..
he makes some room to this length delivery and chops it hard over point fielder to come back for a couple of runs
length delivery outside off, he dabs it towards cover
and he is greeted with a slap through midwicket by Hussey. The fielder at midwicket misfielded actually, the ball went through him
goes for a slog sweep, but is not to the pitch of the ball, he misses and it flicks his pad on its way to the keeper, down the leg side
tossed up and it's slightly fuller, enough for the batsman to get close to the pitch of it and drive it through extra cover
flatter delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and defends it to off
flighted delivery on off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it back to the bowler
flighted delivery on off, the batsman waits as the ball is slow, driven down to long-on
tossed up delivery on off, Hussey gets on with his business, he chips it over mid-off and sends it all the way
keeps it full outside off, the batsman comes forward and pushes it tentatively towards mid-on
now he bowls it on the off stump line, the batsman comes half forward and pushes it to mid-on
he bowls it on a length, but wide outside off, swings further away. The batsman leaves it alone

keeps it there on a length, the batsman defends it off the back foot towards off side, and they call for a single towards cover point, but they make the fatal mistake of taking on Faulkener, who just had to move a few paces to his left. He picks it up and takes down the stumps with a direct hit and now Manan Vohra joins the openers back in the dugout..Where was the run in that one!
that one is a beauty! That is one ball that makes Sreesanth dangerous. On a length on off stump and leaves the batsman late, beats him in his defence
fuller length delivery just outside off, it goes with some shape as well, the batsman lets it go through
and again, this time the batsman pushes it towards the non-striker where the bowler fields
another delivery, just short of driving length, the batsman defends
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and defends
slower length delivery on off, the batsman waits and works it towards midwicket for a single
flighted delivery on off, it is driven down to mid-off
and Chandila draws an outside edge with a tossed up delivery as the batsman tries to flick it to the on side, he gets a leading edge past first slip to short third man

caught at third-man! It's a different day, that's all we can say for Sreesanth. It was a length delivery wide outside off and it swings away too, the batsman throws his bat at that and gets a thick edges that flies straight down the throat of third man
another dab and another quick run, this time towards mid-off
length delivery outside off with some shape in it, Mandeep waits on the back foot and flat bats it towards wide mid-on
fuller length delivery just outside off, some swing in it too, the batsman comes forward and dabs it on off side for a single and makes it just in time

that's a good catch at mid-off by Trivedi! It was a check shot played off a length ball by Gilly and it floated over the right shoulder, Trivedi takes a few steps back and stretches to pluck that out. Another match, another failure for Gilly.
wild delivery down the leg side this time, the keeper dives and gets a hand to it, parries it down to fine leg
bowls a short of length delivery on the pads, Mandeep goes for a pull, but it hits the thigh pad and rolls fine on the leg side, the batsmen steal a couple
flatter and on off stump line from round the wicket, the batsman defends it off the back foot
flighted outside off, the batsman goes down on his knee to sweep and plays it towards short fine
this time he stays on the back foot and chops it on to gully
again, a very slow delivery and Mandeep chooses to sweep it from outside off, misses and gets hit on the pad
comes forward and nudges the tossed up delivery to short fine leg
bowls it slow outside off and Mandeep goes down on his knee to sweep, gets hit on the pads, but it is outside off
this is a good strike! He moves outside the leg stump and smashes the length delivery over extra cover, it just lands inside the rope..
tossed up outside off, it's full too, the batsman slices it over point for a couple. A good throw from the deep would have had him
he dances down the pitch and tries to slam it over the infield, but makes no connection..
he opens up his stance but punches the short of length delivery straight to mid-off
length delivery, and he jabs at it, punches it forcefully down the ground to long-on
he gets a fuller delivery on off stump that he slices straight to point
he tries to punch it down the ground, but it gets to him a touch quicker than he thought, ends up punching it back past the bowler to mid-off
quick back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman stands tall and punches it to mid-on
another short delivery, Samson pulls it all along the ground, down to deep backward square leg
shortish delivery, this time he waits in the crease and drags it to deep square leg
finally Rahane decides to charge down the pitch. the ball was short but then he adjusted well to go through with his shot, he tennis forehands it over extra cover
short delivery outside off, the batsman plays a controlled pull towards deep square leg
he walks down the pitch and defends the back of length delivery to cover
short of length delivery outside off, he plays a short arm jab over mid-on, it looked a decent hit initially, but it just cleared mid-on
he comes forward and pushes the tossed up delivery to deep point
this one is short and turning away outside off, but Samson tries to pull it from there, it goes as far as midwicket
he comes forward and pushes it to deep cover
tossed up delivery on off, he comes forward to drives and ends up just chipping it over the bowler' head, maybe a Mohammad Irfan would have swallowed it
he bowls a low trajectory delivery on the pads, Rahane calmly dabs it towards square leg, with soft hands, and comes back for an easy couple
tosses it up and it ends up being a low full toss, driven down the ground to long-off
he walks across the stumps again, gets a slower ball outside leg stump that he dabs towards deep midwicket for a single
short delivery with not much pace in it, Rahane pulls it down on the ground, towards deep square leg
where did he generate the pace on that! He has been hitting them off the back foot and this one looked like another one of those pushes, but this beats the fielder at deep extra cover with ease
oye, he almost drives it back to the bowler! It was a fuller delivery and a touch slower, the batsman comes forward and drives it a little off balance..
he stays in the crease and punches the length delivery straight to cover
bowls a short of length delivery outside off, the batsman works it to the right of mid-on fielder for a single
another top spinner aimed at off stump, Samson drives it down the ground to long off
goes on the back foot, allows the ball to turn and punches it to long-off
he comes forward and seeing it's a googly, turns it to square leg with the use of his wrists
bowls a loopy delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward to drive and gets an inside edge to deep square leg
he takes a step down the pitch and defends the tossed up delivery to the leg side
bowls the top spinner which is slightly short in length, allows Rahane to go back and push it to deep midwicket
he stays on the back foot and punches the length delivery to deep extra cover for a single
he walks across his stumps and flicks the length delivery to deep square leg
back of length delivery on the stumps, the batsman dabs it to midwicket for a single

dropped at first slip! Another fuller length delivery outside off and Samson plays a loose drive, he gets a thick outside edge straight to the right of the first slip, but Harris drops is right when the commentators were speaking about the improvement in Kings XI's fielding.. irony
oh nicely punched shot! first runs for Samson! He comes forward to a length ball and pushes it with a lot of timing past the man at extra cover
back of length delivery and comes in a touch from wide of the crease, the batsman gets an inside edge on to his pads, they take a quick single
and he gets a slider as well and gets hit on the pad, but it was slightly going down the leg side and that is what saves the man from Kerala

and Hodge had no idea about this one! He plants his front foot forward assuming the ball was going to turn away, but it keeps coming in with the angle and hits him right in front. An easy decision for the umps
here comes the googly from wide of the crease, the batsman goes for a drive to the off, but inside edges it to short fine
bowls it shorter and quicker, it turns a bit but Hodge has enough time to punch it to extra cover
more air in this one, the batsman comes forward and drives it to deep midwicket with a wristy flick
tossed up delivery outside off, the batsman drives it to cover off the front foot
he bowls the effort ball that bounces over the bat as Hodge goes for a cut

he charges down the track and Azhar sees him coming out, bowls it short. The batsman gets an inside edge to fine leg and was struggling as he tries to come back for a second. Dives in, and a better throw would have had him
length delivery outside off, the batsman defends it to point
waits on the back foot for the length ball to come to him, then turns his wrists to work it to deep square leg
short of length delivery outside off at a gentle pace, Rahane punches it mid-off
floats it up on the middle stump line from wide of the crease, the batsman comes forward and drives it to mid-on
and another rising delivery outside off, the batsman goes back and defends it towards cover
short of length delivery on off stump, Hodge goes back and defends it down the pitch
short delivery outside off, Hodge was ready for that, he plays a controlled pull and plays it in the gap at deep backward square leg, twists his back to place that right in the gap
short of length delivery on off and middle line, Rahane goes back and flicks it off his hips towards deep square leg
and again, he is not coming forward today, punches it to the off side off the back foot
he stays on the back foot and punches the length delivery to mid-off
oye! That is a ggoodd delivery! It shapes in the air, then hits the pitch and leaves the batsman. Hodge gets beaten
short of length delivery on the stumps, Rahane goes back and punches it to wide mid-on for a single
back of length delivery just outside off, it squares up the batsman a touch, he ends up steering it to third man
back of length delivery outside off, the batsman stays on the back foot and defends it to point
bowls a fuller length on the middle stump, the batsman tries to whip it towards midwicket, but gets a leading edge towards off as the ball straightens
and he draws the outside edge with a fuller length delivery outside off, but there is no one at third slip and this one slides down to third man boundary
bowls a teasing line outside off, the batsman comes forward and lets it go through to the keeper
bowls it short of length outside off, the batsman punches it to mid-on off the back foot
length delivery widish outside off, the batsman lets it go through
he tries to punch it off the back foot to the off side, but gets a thick inside edge past his stumps, down to fine leg
back of length delivery, but this one is on the pads and Hodge does well to dab it with soft hands towards deep square leg for a quick couple
he bowls a slower length delivery from wide of the crease, Rahane goes on the back foot and dabs it towards midwicket for a quick single
length delivery on off stump, it goes straight on and the batsman defends it back to the bowler

another one-hander for Gilchrist! That the batsman played a horrible nothing poke off a length delivery is not really important here. He got a thickish outside edge that was dying towards the right side of Gilly, who stuck his hand out and swallows it up
keeps it tight on off stump with a length delivery, more defence by the batsman
he waits on the back foot and defends the length ball to the off side
short of length delivery outside off, the batsman goes back and chops it towards point

what a teasing delivery and a very good one-handed diving catch by Gilly! He bowls it on a length, draws Dravid forward, but it is slightly wide. Dravid is not able to cover the swing on it and ends up getting a thick outside edge that flies to the right of keeper..
lovely shot that one! He went on the back foot and brought is bat down wrapped in timing, he crunches it through wide mid-on with a wristy whip
on the pads, Rahul misses the flick and it hits the thigh pad, they sneak a single
the young bowler tests the legend with a quick short ball and he does well as Dravid is slow on this one
short of length delivery, but he gives some width to Dravid, who rises up with the ball and spanks it off the back foot through extra cover
keeps bowling short of length and on off stump, Rahane goes back and works it to deep midwicket
bowls a quickish short delivery outside off, Rahane stands tall and punches it back to the bowler
good line with his outswinger, Dravid stretches forward and defends it towards cover point
strays on to the pads, Dravid's initial movement is forward but he quickly goes back and flicks it through midwicket. Classic
length delivery, not much swing in this one, Dravid defends it from the crease
oh he beats Dravid with a beautiful teasing outswinger. Dravid came forward and was leaning on it, but the ball swings pass
he comes forward and defends a length delivery to point
bowls fuller outswinger wide outside off, the batsman lets it go through
length delivery outside off, Dravid punches it to extra cover and a misfield allows a single
back of length delivery outside off, goes straight on, the batsman punches it to mid-off off the back foot
the only shot that was missing comes now, he plays a tennis forehand off a short delivery outside off, but mistimes it completely, it ends up as simple catch for the fielder at mid-on.
the elbow goes high, the bat comes down straight, he is right over the line of the ball, not to mention the power, he spanks the full delivery through extra cover
he is getting a move on now. Length delivery outside off, he takes a decent forward stride and just launches it over wide mid-on for yet another boundary
back of length delivery outside off, Watson comes forward and defends it towards gully
tries to go down the ground again, but the swing takes it away from the bat. He gets a thick outside edge over gully, down to third man
oye! That's a classic! Length delivery, it's driven on the up back past the bowler with a lot of power and more of timing... B Utiful
length delivery on off stump, Rahane waits on the back foot and pushes it towards midwicket for a quick single
goes back and across and dabs the length delivery down to short fine
walks across the stumps, but Harris bowls it down the leg stump
he bowls it a little straight and that is enough for Watson to punch it through midwicket, it speeds along the turf
length delivery outside off that shapes away from the batsman, beats the bat again
he goes on the back foot and whips the short of length delivery to the gap at midwicket
he stays on the back foot and allows the ball to swing, then punches it to wide mid-off where the fielder makes a good diving stop
keeps that on short of length outside off, the batsman punches it back to the bowler
back of length delivery at 131 kph, it swings away from the batsman after pitching outside off. Rahane leaves it alone
gets it to shape away a touch, but it is pitched on middle and leg, Watson nudges it to deep square leg
back of length delivery on offstump, the batsman gets up on his toes to work it on the leg side, but inside edge it on to his pads, then towards point
and to complete it all, a play and a miss off an excellent delivery outside off that leaves the batsman and squares him up
it's a length delivery on the stumps, Watson comes forward and drives it stylishly through midwicket
length delivery outside off and Watson comes forward to play an uppish drive, but he gets it off the outside half of the bat, over cover point for a boundary
fuller delivery but this one is on the pads, Watson has no problems in flicking this powerfully through backward square leg
another one of those, but this time just short enough for the batsman to adjust late and defend it to point
bowls an excellent away going delivery just outside off. It draws the batsman forward and then swings past the outside edge
now Harris starts by slipping it down the leg side
length delivery outside off, the batsman comes forward and punches it back to the bowler
short of length delivery, but this one is too far down the leg side
he comes back and across to whip it to the leg side, but ends up pushing it back to the bowler
bowls slightly short of length outside off, and it goes away, Rahane punches it to cover off the back foot
another away swinger at 127 kph, Rahane comes forward and pushes it towards point
now this one goes the other way outside off, the batsman steers it down to third man
he gets it swing it like a banana, but this is down the leg side and flicks Watson's pads along the way to the boundary
